hooks.command: FILE=$(echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.file_path // empty') && [ -n "$FILE" ] && [[ "$FILE" == *.php ]] && vendor/bin/php-cs-fixer fix "$FILE" --quiet 2>/dev/null || true

FILE=$(echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.file_path // empty') && [[ "$FILE" == *composer.lock* || "$FILE" == *.env.local* || "$FILE" == *migrations/Version* ]] && echo 'BLOCKED: No modificar composer.lock, .env.local ni migraciones existentes directamente' >&2 && exit 2 || exit 0
